result.keyword: What's the best CRM for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **HubSpot or Pipedrive**\. They strike the best balance between ease of use, functionality and room to grow.

However, the right choice depends on whether you're primarily managing sales, customer relationships, marketing or ongoing client accounts.

## My top 5 CRM recommendations

![21 Best CRM Enterprise Software Reviewed For 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/E3oBllJko6DSkC1G-YxonkpSd-C9EJzphRnffFc13dKq176hHlHIBef_KD3uo3Rj4h1fcldcCQ6woqfNfkWWmNW8Rs1_qiHKjMrnT7yrtNAkkpWII-RvqcBN_-0EERClJKgsbj3AQum9lvjpnXVV_ofvoY4dYvM4uvHF3Aza7RJS9SAW_-O73lSaxuQ1_7Sl?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. HubSpot CRM**

(Best overall)

Free entry-level plan

- Very user-friendly.
- Contact and deal management.
- Email tracking and sales pipeline.
- Marketing and customer service tools available as you grow.

Best for teams wanting an all-round customer management platform.

[HubSpot website](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm)

---

![Pipedrive Culture | Comparably](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/LL0qs5ZEn5bajHXZMpCmlJ4Q8G8bG-uCRPdMDaugOTZ5M83xr5SdfSJtpaTsU9pV5XZU_j6tdK98aLeb5eQtmf3jAulEyqWXtwu_NCqqantmt4RgTKgW92e5jqAqiwI5Gvz6HoJSFRLf0DV2WCKF0F5we1qdhyYgERFOvFPWSwO__wWT47lukE3R9cSOeuBr?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Pipedrive**

(Best for sales teams)

From approximately A\$19/user/month, annual billing

- Excellent visual sales pipeline.
- Tracks leads, opportunities and follow-ups.
- Easy to understand and implement.
- Good sales reporting.

Best for teams focused on converting leads into customers.

[Pipedrive website](https://www.pipedrive.com/)

---

![TheProwess | Zoho CRM'de Yeni Dönem: Eski Arayüz 15 Temmuz'da Tamamen Kaldırılıyor](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhOzD_IXTeMyjegHs7_31H-nZlvGoIQWY2PfiTmHpwuQOA09A9NutmTAM8TWT2HF-7JryptkgV-lS_xHcaI7d43ujbBUTvqfxj-z3nk-gdRQr3-Ei-qigHIPik-T14ytWC4EuYLl0he93dU9qCw5sHTS1LPdprZuUjTWv0UHX5wzcmxSTdtKBrPPwq-xdGBE?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Zoho CRM**

(Best value)

Free for up to 3 users; paid from approximately A\$22/user/month

- Lots of customisation.
- Automation and reporting.
- Integrates with other Zoho applications.
- Good functionality for the price.

Best for teams wanting flexibility without expensive software.

[Zoho website](https://www.zoho.com/crm/)

---

![Descargar Freshsales CRM varies-with-device para Web Apps - Filehippo.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ymGWkXtkAC7MoWysGML3OKgHF9O0MPKH1PfAAeDjk1aaZrRWaVBb9r5y-Kf_8j4xYqKU0KB7QvzLaYT0HE0Vv7VVhtrsyXiqQzkmNrQWCEXFxliHIByLJsgnf2ztG74VQ6KpL_qyhXQE--CUkaD3WIbFGDInuBn5hMKNEjmTwahJ5xR1Qf4y9c43huoiOovk?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Freshsales**

(Best for communication)

From approximately A\$15/user/month

- Built-in calling and email.
- Lead scoring.
- Sales automation.
- Useful customer communication history.

Best for teams that spend a lot of time speaking with prospects.

[Freshsales website](https://www.freshworks.com/crm/sales/)

---

![monday CRM Pricing 2026](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/WZBgT5LMk0hlFDbaDE7Oe4dhBXC6jwiZ6pxJGMVpcsMwVDkfCsT-dv0wBTUlpWZGmKWrqtZzAFNyzRQlCrz_hWVJ6YgQV4oLobEUiDlHsz9xGU-ITPOcFHJE_ZMqNVgoo49BNsro_rnsBLhXi0WSPepHWndcSHEhdcMSpAX7ifNdKDDy7TsZwlbZv04co7WT?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday CRM**

(Best for workflow management)

From approximately A\$19/seat/month, annual billing

- Highly visual interface.
- Customisable workflows.
- Customer and project tracking.
- Good team collaboration.

Best for teams managing both clients and internal projects.

[monday CRM website](https://monday.com/crm)

## Which would I choose?

| Your priority | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Best all-round CRM | HubSpot |
| Managing sales leads | Pipedrive |
| Keeping costs down | Zoho |
| Calling and emailing prospects | Freshsales |
| Managing clients and projects | monday CRM |
